name: Civil ID number
issuer: the Public Authority for Civil Information (PACI)
note: Kuwait's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the Tax Department issues no TIN to individuals; their Civil ID number from the Public Authority for Civil Information (PACI) serves as the TIN on request; 12 digits including the date of birth. Read as given on registration, to citizens and residents (the sheet calls it the Kuwaiti Civil ID without saying who holds one). No check rule, age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Kuwait: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: For individuals, a TIN is not issued by the Tax Dept. but their Kuwaiti Civil ID number issued by the Public Authority for Civil Information (PACI) is used as their TIN upon their request. ... Individuals: Their 12-digit Civil ID numbers issued by the Public Authority for Civil Information (PACI) which contains the person’s date of birth.
